title: Five moves you can do from the couch before you keep scrolling
caption: Exercises you can do while sitting, or right beside where you sit: Seated Knee Lift, Shoulder Blade Squeeze, Sit-to-Stand, Air Squat and Wall Slide. Do all five once, then keep scrolling. Save this for the next scroll.

overlays.text: You scrolled your way to five moves you can do right where you sit.
Seated Knee Lift. 10 reps. Sit tall on the edge, lift one knee, then the other.
Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Phone down, squeeze your shoulder blades, let go.

scenes.footer: Squat. The seat is your guide.

overlays.text: Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Stand up from the seat with no hands, sit back down slowly.

scenes.footer: Squat. The seat stays behind you.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Stand in front of the seat, sit your hips back, stand tall.
Wall Slide. 10 reps. Back to the wall beside you, slide your arms up, then down.

scenes.footer: About four minutes. Then the phone is yours.

overlays.text: Do all five once. Then scroll.

scenes.footer: Save this for the next scroll.

overlays.text: Where are you scrolling from right now?
